stepExplanation:
Using Snell's Law with n₁ = 1 (air), θ₁ = 45°, n₂ = 1.5:
$$1 \times \sin 45° = 1.5 \times \sin\theta_2$$
$$\sin\theta_2 = \frac{\sin 45°}{1.5} = \frac{0.707}{1.5} = 0.471$$
$$\theta_2 = \sin^{-1}(0.471) = 28.1°$$
stepBody: Using Snell's Law, calculate the angle of refraction. Given: n_air = 1, θ₁ = 45°, n_glass = 1.5, sin 45° = 0.707. Give your answer in degrees.
